description_en: Queries the SSL configuration of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例的SSL配置情况
name: DescribeDBInstanceSSL

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

ACL.description_en:
The authentication method of the ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. Valid values:
cert
prefer
verify-ca
verify-full (supported for RDS PostgreSQL 12 and later)
ACL.description_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例的认证方法，返回值：
cert
prefer
verify-ca
verify-full（RDS PostgreSQL 12以上支持）

CAType.description_en:
The server certificate type of the ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. Valid values:
aliyun: Uses a cloud certificate.
custom: Uses a custom certificate
CAType.description_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例的服务器证书类型，返回值：
aliyun：使用云证书
custom：使用自定义证书

ClientCACert.description_en: The public key of the client certificate authority (CA) for the ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks
ClientCACert.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例的客户端证书授权机构公钥

ClientCACertExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the client certificate authorization public key for the ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
ClientCACertExpireTime.description_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例的客户端证书授权机构公钥有效期。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。

暂不支持该参数，无需关注

ClientCertRevocationList.description_en: The client revocation certificate file for the ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks
ClientCertRevocationList.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例的客户端吊销证书文件

ForceEncryption.description_en: Indicates whether the [forced Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) encryption]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95715.html） feature is enabled for the ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance. Valid values:
ForceEncryption.description_zh:
SQL Server实例的[强制SSL加密功能]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95715.html）是否已开启，返回值：

1：开启。
0：未开启

LastModifyStatus.description_en:
The current SSL link configuration status of the ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. Valid values:

success: The configuration is successful.
setting: The configuration is in progress.
failed: The configuration failed
LastModifyStatus.description_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例当前SSL链路配置状态，返回值：

success：成功
setting：设置中
failed：失败

ModifyStatusReason.description_en: The reason for the current SSL link configuration status of the ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks
ModifyStatusReason.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例当前SSL链路配置状态对应的原因

ReplicationACL.description_en:
The authentication method for replication permissions of an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. Valid values:
cert
prefer
verify-ca
verify-full (supported by RDS PostgreSQL 12 and later)
ReplicationACL.description_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例的replication权限认证方法，返回值：
cert
prefer
verify-ca
verify-full（RDS PostgreSQL 12以上支持）

RequireUpdate.description_en:
Indicates whether the SSL certificate needs to be updated. Valid values:

The SSL certificate is valid for one year. If the certificate is not updated after it expires, clients that use encrypted connections cannot connect to the instance.
<details>
<summary>MySQL, SQL Server</summary>

No: No update is required.
Yes: An update is required.
</details>

<details>
<summary>PostgreSQL</summary>

0: No update is required.
1: An update is required.

</details>
RequireUpdate.description_zh:
是否需要更新SSL证书，返回值：

SSL证书有效期为1年，证书到期后不更新，会导致使用加密连接的客户端程序无法正常连接实例。
<details>
<summary>MySQL、SQL Server</summary>

No：无需更新
Yes：需更新
</details>

<details>
<summary>PostgreSQL</summary>

0：无需更新
1：需更新

</details>

RequireUpdateItem.description_en: The list of server certificates that need to be updated for the ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks
RequireUpdateItem.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例需要更新的服务器证书列表

RequireUpdateReason.description_en: The reason why the certificates need to be updated for the ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks
RequireUpdateReason.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例需要更新证书的原因

SSLCreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the server certificate for the ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. This parameter is valid only when CAType is set to aliyun
SSLCreateTime.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例的服务器证书创建时间，当CAType配置为aliyun时有效

SSLEnabled.description_en:
The SSL encryption status. Valid values:
<details>
<summary>MySQL, SQL Server</summary>

Yes: Enabled.
No: Not enabled.
</details>

<details>
<summary>PostgreSQL</summary>

on: Enabled.
off: Not enabled.

</details>
SSLEnabled.description_zh:
SSL的加密状态，返回值：
<details>
<summary>MySQL、SQL Server</summary>

Yes：已开启
No：未开启
</details>

<details>
<summary>PostgreSQL</summary>

on：已开启
off：未开启

</details>

SSLExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the SSL certificate. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

ServerCAUrl.description_en: The URL of the CA certificate that is used to issue the server certificate for the ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks
ServerCAUrl.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例签发服务器证书的CA证书URL

ServerCert.description_en: The content of the server certificate for the ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks
ServerCert.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例的服务器证书内容

ServerKey.description_en: The private key of the server certificate for the ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks
ServerKey.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例的服务器证书私钥

TlsVersion.description_en: The specified minimum [TLS version]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95715.html） for the ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance. Valid values: 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2
TlsVersion.description_zh: SQL Server实例已指定的[最低LTS版本号]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95715.html），当前支持1.0、1.1、1.2
